mainEntity.name: What is The Arab Card Game?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Arab Card Game is a card game that celebrates Arab culture, humor, and shared experiences — designed for Arabs and their friends everywhere. It's perfect for family gatherings, Eid parties, and anyone who grew up in an Arab household.

mainEntity.name: Is The Arab Card Game appropriate for all ages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! The Arab Card Game is family-friendly and designed to be played by all ages at gatherings, holidays like Eid and Ramadan, and everyday hangouts.
Yes, we ship to Arab diaspora communities worldwide including the US, Canada, UK, Australia, Germany, France, and more.

mainEntity.name: Is this a good gift for Arabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. The Arab Card Game is one of the most unique and culturally resonant gifts for Arabs and Arab Americans. It makes a great Eid gift, birthday gift, or housewarming present for Arab families.
The Arab Card Game can be played by groups — ideal for 4 or more players, making it perfect for Arab family gatherings and parties.
